scope: read-only design for a small development pilot; no large PCAP execution, no test labels, no network API
primary_question: Does an actual lazy path reduce end-to-end cost under equal observable packet prefixes, after charging extraction, waiting, inference, routing, fusion, and API serialization?

historical_asymmetric_reference.stats_observation: full segment counters and full segment duration
historical_asymmetric_reference.temporal_observation: first 64 packet lengths, directions, and inter-arrival times
historical_asymmetric_reference.interpretation: reference only; not a fair prefix comparison and not an acceleration claim

prefix_rule.stats: derive packet count, bytes, direction totals, variance, and duration from the first P packets only; duration ends at packet P
prefix_rule.temporal: derive sequence features from the same first P packet lengths, directions, and P-1 inter-arrival values
prefix_rule.training: fit/calibrate a separate view bundle for each P in development roles; do not reuse full-segment Stats or 64-packet models as an equal-prefix claim
prefix_rule.short_flow: if observed packet_count < P, emit short_flow and do not pad, impute, or score it in the P-supported quality cohort
prefix_rule.common_cohort: for each P, compare views only on the same rows with packet_count >= P; report short-flow coverage beside every cost table
prefix_rule.prefix_1: not in the primary grid because the requested grid starts at 4; if added later, IAT-derived fields are explicitly unavailable rather than fabricated

support_audit.allowed_inputs: packet count and parser/schema status only
support_audit.forbidden_inputs: test labels, predictions, group/family labels, and acceptance decisions
support_audit.claim_rule: do not state that short flows are numerous at P=64 until this label-free histogram is measured

controls.first_only: one selected view using the same P-specific bundle
controls.full_call: maximum-call-cost reference that always materializes both P-specific views, then applies one frozen combination rule; it is not a quality upper bound
controls.lazy_fixed_trigger: same order and combination rule, trigger fixed before measurement
controls.lazy_runtime_router: candidate first-state-only router; threshold and budget frozen before any acceptance scoring
controls.random_budget_match: optional development diagnostic matching the lazy call count; not a latency substitute

quality_reporting.supported_cohort_table: for rows with packet_count >= P and status ok, report quality metrics on the common P-supported cohort
quality_reporting.all_request_deployment_table: in the same table, report the locked deployment policy over every observed request, including short_flow, timeout, unsupported, and other failures
quality_reporting.fallback_lock: before evaluation, lock one fallback per method/P: partial-prefix only when its separately fitted/calibrated bundle is available, otherwise abstain; timeout uses the same prelocked fallback
quality_reporting.short_flow_rule: never drop short_flow rows from deployment denominators or describe supported-cohort quality as overall deployment quality
quality_reporting.quality_upper_bound: full_call is not an upper bound; an oracle/error-correction upper bound, if shown, must be explicitly non-deployable and separate from all baselines

timing.clock: time.perf_counter_ns for elapsed durations; event order uses monotonic timestamps
timing.request_boundary: start before raw segment acquisition or local API handler entry; stop after fusion result serialization
timing.accounting: nested stage spans are recorded once; total_request_ns is measured independently; unattributed_ns = total minus non-overlapping stage spans
timing.waiting: offline replay records observation_wait_ns as not_applicable; a future online run records arrival-to-prefix-ready time separately from CPU processing
timing.model_load: cold checkpoint load is a separate metric and excluded from warm per-request latency; report it rather than hiding it
timing.network: no external network or remote API in this protocol; local API dispatch and serialization are measured separately

execution_controls.batch_128_purpose: throughput and amortized batch cost; final partial batch reported separately
execution_controls.method_order: fixed interleaved order across rounds; same prefix, batch, and cache condition in each round
execution_controls.warmup: three non-measured warmup batches after model load; record warmup rows separately
execution_controls.cold_run: one isolated process per method/prefix for checkpoint-load and process-start timing
execution_controls.warm_run: same process after warmup, with at least five interleaved measurement rounds
execution_controls.file_cache: do not claim controlled OS file-cache state; record whether each round is cold-process or warm-process
execution_controls.cache_policy: primary latency run disables feature/probability cache; a separate cache-hit diagnostic reports cache hits and actual model calls separately
execution_controls.randomness: no stochastic model fitting during measurement; all hashes, model versions, and feature source hashes locked before scoring

failure_policy.denominator: all observed eligible segment requests, including failures and short flows
failure_policy.timeout_rule: fix timeout threshold and injected failure rate in development; never delete failed rows
charts: stacked status-rate chart by prefix and method
successful-request latency p50/p95 chart with all-request latency beside it
stage-failure count table including feature, second expert, router, fusion, and API
failure_policy.reporting: report counts and rates per method x prefix x batch x cache condition; failed requests remain in throughput and all-request denominator

artifacts.summary_table: method x prefix x batch x warm_state with count, short_flow_rate, failure_rate, mean, p50, p95, throughput
artifacts.environment_manifest: python,OS,CPU,RAM,tshark version,thread settings,model hashes,feature source hash,protocol hash
artifacts.negative_results: explicitly retain no-call, all-call, all-short-flow, timeout, and no-latency-improvement outcomes

stop_before_full_run_if: prefix support audit cannot produce a common cohort
Stats cannot be constructed from the same first P packets
stage timers overlap or leave an unexplained large residual
a method silently reads full-segment duration or bytes for a prefix row
failure rows are dropped or timeout rates are not reported
stop_rules.success_is_not_assumed: cost reduction is reportable only after equal-prefix fairness, complete stage accounting, stable repeated ordering, and failure-inclusive denominators pass
